name: interactive-os-learning-platform
description: Interactive Operating System Learning & Simulation Platform combining CPU Scheduling, Memory Management, Page Replacement, Deadlock (Banker's Algorithm), Disk Scheduling, Process Synchronization, and Learning Mode.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: node node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js -n API,WEB -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
